title: Download Free ALI MEA™ Protocols for Advanced 3D Neural Tissue & Brain Slice Research
body_markdown:
Unlock proven workflows for recording and culturing complex neural tissues with[ALI MEA](https://www.multichannelsystems.com/products/ali-mea) from Multi Channel Systems. These downloadable protocols provide step-by-step guidance for working with human brain slices, cerebral organoids, neurospheres, and other 3D neural tissue models using ALI MEA. From tissue preparation and placement to long-term culture and electrophysiological recordings, these resources are designed to help researchers establish reliable, reproducible experiments and maximize data quality.


The ALI MEA platform combines air-liquid interface culture with high-quality electrophysiological recording, enabling improved tissue oxygenation, long-term viability, and functional monitoring of complex neural networks. Whether you're studying disease models, network dynamics, drug responses, or translational neuroscience applications, these protocols offer practical, expert-developed methods to accelerate your research and get started faster. **Complete the form below** to access your free protocols and explore the full potential of ALI MEA technology.


**Learn more about other[organoid research solutions](https://www.harvardbioscience.com/applications/organoid-research) from HBio.**
